name: Bloodline of the Elite: Sensory Type

system.description: As an Action, while exploring with your Byakugan active, you can perform a Perimeter Sweep ability. When you do, for the next 10 minutes, you and allied creatures with you, gain a rank of mastery to the next saving throw made against a triggered trap.
